user.title: Choose your purifier
user.description: Pick the unit to add. It must be powered on and in Bluetooth range.

setup.title: Model and key

data.protocol_number: Protocol number (hex) - leave the default unless told otherwise

error.bad_key: That is not a valid 16-byte key (base64 or 32 hex characters), or the protocol number is not hex.
error.not_in_range: Home Assistant cannot see this purifier right now. Move a Bluetooth adapter or proxy closer.
error.cannot_connect: Connected, but the purifier did not answer. Try again.
error.invalid_auth: The purifier rejected this key. It belongs to a different unit or slot.
error.pair_failed: Pairing failed - see the Home Assistant log ("pairing failed"). Keep LINK held, stay close to the unit, and check internet access.
error.no_master_uuid: This unit's Bluetooth ID could not be read, so it cannot be paired from here. Paste a key instead, or use tools/gg_probe.py --pair.
error.wrong_unit: This device did not accept the purifier handshake. It is probably a different Aplix product (for example a gateway). Go back and choose the other unit.

abort.no_scanner: Home Assistant has no Bluetooth adapter or Bluetooth proxy that can connect to devices, so it cannot find the purifier. Check Settings > Devices & services > Bluetooth, add an adapter or an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy, then try again.
abort.no_devices_found: Home Assistant's Bluetooth can see {seen} devices, but none of them is a purifier. Make sure the purifier is plugged in and on, close the Guardian app on your phone (a connected phone can hide the purifier), and put the Bluetooth adapter or proxy within about 10 feet (3 m) of the purifier. Then try again.
abort.already_configured: This purifier is already set up.
